ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law of the People's Republic of China on Anti-Money Laundering (effective 1 January 2007, as amended); Measures for Customer Due Diligence and the Retention of Customer Identity Materials and Transaction Records of Financial Institutions (PBOC, CBIRC, CSRC and SAFE Order No. 1 [2022], effective 1 March 2022); Administrative Measures for Beneficial Owner Information (PBOC and SAMR Order No. 3 [2024], effective 1 November 2024); Counter-Terrorism Law of the People's Republic of China (2016); Criminal Law Articles 191 and 312; and SAMR beneficial-owner filing requirements integrated with the enterprise registration information platform.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation or equivalent registration certificate of each non-resident shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry or competent registrar in the shareholder's jurisdiction of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Apostille-only for Hague Apostille Convention member states: local notarization followed by an Apostille certificate issued by the designated Competent Authority; no PRC consular legalization is required. For non-member states only: local notarization, then authentication by the state foreign affairs department, then consular legalization by the Embassy or Consulate of the People's Republic of China authority with jurisdiction. The two authentication pathways are parallel, mutually exclusive, and never sequential.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Certificate of Active Status
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registry or tax authority in the shareholder's jurisdiction of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille track for Apostille member states: notarize, then apostille through the designated competent authority; do not add consular legalization. Non-Apostille track: notarize, authenticate at the foreign ministry/competent department, then obtain PRC consular legalization. No document should receive both an Apostille and a consular legalization.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution of the parent company or shareholder appointing the WFOE legal representative, directors and supervisor, and granting the Power of Attorney for incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of directors of the non-resident shareholder and a licensed notary public in the shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: For member states of the Hague Apostille Convention: notarize the board resolution and PoA, then obtain an Apostille from the state-designated Competent Authority; PRC Embassy legalization is not used. For non-member states: notarize, have the document authenticated by the foreign affairs or state department, then legalize before the PRC Embassy/Consulate with consular jurisdiction. Apostille and consular legalization are alternative routes only.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association / Memorandum and Articles / Statutes of the non-resident shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company secretary, registered agent or notary public in the shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Apostille Convention state: notarize the copy and apply for an Apostille certificate with the designated competent authority; Chinese consular legalization must not be added. Non-Convention state: notarize, authenticate through the national foreign ministry, then finish with consular legalization at the PRC Embassy/Consulate. The two tracks are mutually exclusive.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter from the shareholder's principal bank covering account history, conduct and standing
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Bank institution maintaining the shareholder's operating accounts
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: If the bank can issue a notarized or certified copy, banks in Apostille states should have the document apostilled by the competent authority; no PRC consular legalization follows. Banks in non-Apostille states must follow notarization, foreign ministry authentication and PRC consular legalization. Apostille and consular legalization are parallel and never combined.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized passport copies and beneficial owner declaration for each natural person owning 25% or more or exercising control
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the resident/citizenship jurisdiction of each individual beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: For an individual resident in an Apostille Convention state: notarize the passport and UBO declaration and obtain an Apostille; no Chinese consular legalization. For an individual resident in a non-member state: notarize, authenticate at the foreign ministry, then obtain consular legalization from the PRC Embassy. Use one route only, depending on the origin state.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Source of wealth / source of funds statement executed by each substantial shareholder and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Documents issued in Apostille Convention states must be notarized and apostilled by the designated Competent Authority only; no PRC consular legalization. Documents issued in non-member states must be notarized, authenticated by the foreign ministry, and then consular-legalized by the PRC Embassy/Consulate. Apostille and consular legalization are alternative, mutually exclusive authentication paths.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of every shareholder, director, supervisor, legal representative, senior manager and ultimate beneficial owner against: the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List; the UN Security Council Consolidated List; EU and UK financial sanctions consolidated lists; Chinese counter-terrorism and sanctions lists implemented by the PBOC, Ministry of State Security and competent authorities; domestic, foreign and international-organization politically exposed persons databases including PEP family members and close associates as required by FATF Recommendation 12; and commercial watchlists/negative-news sources. Because the used heavy machinery wholesale activity is rated Medium_Risk_Enhanced, enhanced due diligence requires source-of-funds verification, certified documentary evidence for all beneficial owners, a Day-0 sanctions and PEP screen of every name on every consolidated transaction, and continuous re-screening at least monthly or within 24 hours of any adverse media alert, with

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Law of the People's Republic of China (2023 Revision, effective 1 July 2024), Articles 4, 23, 24, 26, 30, 31, 32, 33, 40, 46, 50, 68, 80 and 94; Foreign Investment Law of the People's Republic of China (2020), Articles 6, 17, 28 and 30; Foreign Investment Negative List (2024 Edition); Interim Measures for Market Entity Registration; Regulations on the Registration Administration of Market Entities.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) and the local Market Regulation Administration at the municipality or district level where the WFOE's registered office is located.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Foreign-Invested Enterprise Establishment Registration Application Form, together with the requisite Articles of Association, shareholder register, registered office proof, and statutory officer appointment instruments (the unified company filing dossier).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital and no blocked escrow account requirement apply to a general trading/wholesale WFOE under the current PRC Company Law. The registered capital is subscribed under the capital contribution schedule in the Articles of Association and may be paid in RMB or permitted foreign currency through a licensed bank capital account. The paid-in capital must not be withdrawn or used as collateral before the company satisfies its lawful creditor protection obligations. For second-hand construction machinery wholesale, no additional statutory deposit or escrow rule applies, but the capital contribution period must be expressly stated in the Articles.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the incorporation of the Company as a wholly foreign-owned enterprise limited liability company under the Company Law of the People's Republic of China be and is hereby authorized and approved. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the subscription of share capital be and is hereby approved on the following terms: the sole foreign shareholder shall subscribe to 100% of the registered capital of the Company, in an aggregate amount equal to the registered capital stated in the Articles of Association, payable in cash by wire transfer to a specially opened capital contribution account in China, on or before the contribution deadline set forth in the approved capital contribution schedule; no portion of the paid-up capital shall be withdrawn, offset, pledged, guaranteed, or otherwise encumbered except as permitted by the Company Law and the Foreign Exchange Control Regulations. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office of the Company be and is hereby adopted as the address stated in the Articles of Association, which address is located within the territorial jurisdiction of the local Market Regulation Administration and is suitable for the service of process and statutory notices; the general manager is authorized and instructed to execute and file the lease or other right-of-use document with the competent registry and to cause all corporate records, invoices, contracts, and official letterheads to show such registered office. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the Company shall open and maintain with a licensed commercial bank in the People's Republic of China a RMB basic deposit account and, if required, a foreign currency settlement account and a capital account in the name of the Company; the general manager and the finance controller are hereby jointly authorized to execute all account opening forms, wire instructions, letters of credit, documentary remittance requests, trade settlement instructions, and banking mandates; all payments and disbursements above the authorized credit limit require two authorized signatures, and this dual-control banking authority shall remain binding until amended by a subsequent board resolution. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the following statutory officers be and are hereby appointed to hold office from the date of approval until their successors are duly appointed: [Name of Individual] as Executive Director; [Name of Individual] as Supervisor, who shall not simultaneously serve as Executive Director or General Manager; [Name of Individual] as General Manager; and [Name of Individual] as Legal Representative and Chairperson. Each such officer shall accept office in the prescribed consent form, shall carry out the corporate objects, and shall exercise their powers in conformity with the Articles of Association and applicable law. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the Legal Representative and General Manager be and are hereby jointly instructed to complete all statutory registrations and filings connected with the formation of the Company, including business license issuance, tax registration, social insurance registration, customs registration, foreign exchange filing, seal engraving, banking authorization, and the obtainment of any industrial, environmental, fire safety, or occupational licenses required for the wholesale remarketing, warehousing, and import/export of used hydraulic earthmovers and rollers. This resolution shall be recorded in the corporate minute book and shall continue in full force and effect until expressly amended or revoked by a later board resolution. Adopted by the sole shareholder and the founders on [Date] at [Place], and certified by the Corporate Secretary as a true and complete record of the first board meeting.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Pre-Approval and Foreign Investment Negative List Screening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Market Regulation Administration via the Chinese Integrated Government Service Portal and the National Enterprise Name Registration system.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log in to the local Market Regulation Administration online service portal using the legalized identity documents of the foreign investor; complete the preliminary name registration application in the format 'geographic name + trade name + industry + limited liability company'. The system will screen the proposed name against the national name database and check the proposed foreign-invested business scope against the Foreign Investment Negative List (2024 Edition). If the proposed scope falls within a permitted category, a preliminary name reservation notice is issued online with a unique reservation number. If the proposed scope triggers a restricted category, the investor must first obtain sectoral approval or narrow the scope. For used construction machinery wholesale, no negative-list restriction is normally triggered, but the operator must ensure that no illegally smuggled, stolen, or prohibited machinery is traded and that all units comply with product-quality and import-export controls.
required_dossiers: Foreign investor's certificate of incorporation, notarized, apostilled or consular legalized
Passport or corporate registration certificate of the investor's authorized signatory
Proposed Chinese company name and up to three alternative names
Declaration confirming the proposed business scope does not fall under prohibited foreign investment categories
Power of attorney appointing the local filing agent or legal representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for duplication, re-submit with an alternative name immediately; if the negative list screening flags a restricted business, file a supporting industry-specific approval or amend the business scope to remove restricted activities; if the reservation expires, restart the name pre-approval process within the same online session.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Legalization, Translation and Notarization of WFOE Organizational Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Chinese Embassy or Consulate in the investor's jurisdiction, a recognized notary public in the PRC, and the local SAMR after notarization.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The foreign investor must execute the Articles of Association, capital contribution schedule, board resolutions, and statutory officer appointments in the country of incorporation. These instruments must then be notarized and legalized in accordance with the Hague Apostille Convention or through Chinese consular legalization, depending on the investor's jurisdiction. After the documents arrive in the PRC, they must be translated into simplified Chinese by a qualified translation company; the Chinese version will be the governing version for SAMR registration. The translated Articles and all accompanying originals are then submitted to a PRC notary office for signature verification and issuance of the notarial certificate. The notarial certificate becomes part of the registration dossier and evidences the lawful intent of the foreign shareholder to establish a wholly foreign-owned limited liability company in China.
required_dossiers: Original Certificate of Incorporation of the foreign investor and any name-change evidence
Board resolution or sole member consent of the foreign investor authorizing the WFOE formation
Financial statement or bank solvency certificate evidencing capacity to subscribe registered capital
Proposed Articles of Association in English and simplified Chinese
Passport or ID copy of the proposed PRC legal representative
Power of attorney to the local notarized agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the legalization/apostille is defective, obtain a corrected apostille from the competent authority of the source jurisdiction; if the Chinese translation contains discrepancies, re-translate by a certified translation agency and re-notarize; if the notary rejects the signature, have the legal representative sign again in the presence of the notary and re-file.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Establishment Registration, Business License and Unified Social Credit Code Issuance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Market Regulation Administration (foreign-invested enterprise registration window).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the complete company registration dossier to the local SAMR using the online foreign-invested enterprise filing channel. The application must include the name reservation number, notarized Articles of Association, subscriber capital schedule, business scope, registered office lease, legal representative identity, supervisor consent, and the power of attorney if applicable. SAMR will review the legality and internal consistency of the corporate organs, capital contribution period, and registered scope. Upon approval, SAMR issues the Business License containing the Unified Social Credit Code, which is the legal personality document for the WFOE. The license also functions as the registration certificate for the tax, customs, foreign exchange, social insurance, and statistical registration notifications. The legal representative must personally sign the registration application or submit a notarized power of attorney; the WFOE must thereafter open a capital contribution account within the statutory window.
required_dossiers: Preliminary name reservation notice
Notarized Articles of Association
Registered office lease agreement and landlord title certificate
Consent to appointment of legal representative and supervisor
Passport/ID copies of statutory officers
Foreign investor's certificate of incorporation and legalization chain
Capital contribution schedule and subscription statement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If SAMR issues a correction notice, rectify the exact discrepancies within 15 days and re-submit; if the registered office proof is queried, provide the landlord's building ownership certificate and a renewed lease; if the business scope is considered too broad, narrow it to wholesale-only or obtain separate industry approval; if any original document is missing, re-legalize and upload it before the SAMR deadline.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Registration Statutory Seal, Tax, Social Insurance, Bank, Customs and Foreign Exchange Filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Public Security Bureau approved seal engraving agency; local State Taxation Administration; local Human Resources and Social Security Bureau; licensed commercial bank under the People's Bank of China; General Administration of Customs (GACC) and SAFE-regulated bank branch.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Immediately after issuance of the Business License, the WFOE must procure the company seal, finance seal, invoice seal, legal representative seal, and contract seal from a Public Security Bureau-approved engraving company; the engraving company files the seal data electronically with the police. The company then registers with the competent tax authority for its tax identification, VAT status, payroll tax reporting, invoice quota, and e-invoice system activation. The company must also register social insurance and open a basic deposit account at a licensed bank; the bank will perform beneficial ownership and anti-money laundering due diligence because the company is engaged in cross-border used machinery trade. If the WFOE imports or exports used hydraulic excavators and rollers, it must complete the GACC declaration of customs registration and the SAFE foreign exchange filing through the bank. The trade settlement rails shall include wire transfer and SWIFT documentary letters of credit, subject to the bank's AML sanctions screening.
required_dossiers: Business License and Unified Social Credit Code certificate
Notarized Articles of Association
Seal registration certificate
Legal representative passport/ID
Registered office lease and rent invoice
Tax and social insurance registration forms
Bank account opening package with beneficial ownership declaration
AML questionnaire and source of funds declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank freezes account opening pending beneficial ownership verification, submit a certified corporate structure chart and board resolution of the foreign parent; if tax registration is delayed by information inconsistency, apply for an electronic tax registration correction and re-submit; if customs registration is blocked by absence of operating license, complete the industry licensing in Step 5 and then re-file; if SWIFT LC authority is refused, amend the bank's credit application and provide audited financials.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Industry, Environmental, Fire-Safety and Occupational Licensing for Second-Hand Machinery Warehousing and Trading
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Commerce Department; General Administration of Customs (GACC) port branch; local Ecology and Environment Bureau; local Fire and Rescue Section; local Emergency Management Bureau.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Before stocking used excavators and rollers, file the operational licensing application with the local Commerce Department for the second-hand machinery trading and warehousing record; if any unit crosses the border, file the foreign trade importer/exporter recordal and, if applicable, obtain the used mechanical and electrical product import inspection permission from GACC. File the Environmental Impact Assessment registration record through the online MEE registration system if the operation is limited to indoor warehousing of complete units. Complete the fire protection acceptance review with the local Fire and Rescue Division and obtain the fire acceptance opinion before inventory is placed in the warehouse. Submit a work safety plan to the local Emergency Management Bureau covering the structural loading capacity of the storage racks, forklift operator certificates, emergency response protocols, and hazardous waste containment for accumulated hydraulic fluids. All permits, the business license, and the EIA filing record must be displayed at the registered address. If the company operates purely as a broker without physical possession or warehousing, the physical licensing provisions are not applicable.
required_dossiers: EIA registration filing confirmation code
Business License with wholesale scope
Warehouse lease contract and structural drawings
Fire protection construction drawings and installation certificates
Used machinery inventory list and decontamination records
Contract with licensed hazardous waste transporter
Forklift and special equipment operator certificates
Foreign trade recordal or used machinery import permit if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the EIA registration is returned, correct the classification and re-submit online within 10 working days; if the fire inspection fails, complete the required sprinklers, extinguishers, smoke alarms, or exit modifications and request a re-inspection; if GACC questions the import eligibility of a used excavator, submit its year of manufacture, maintenance history, origin proof, and decontamination certificate; if hazardous waste classification is disputed, obtain an MEE category determination letter and re-classify the waste stream.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Local Commerce Department, local Emergency Management Bureau, local Fire and Rescue Section, local Ecology and Environment Bureau, and the General Administration of Customs (GACC) port of entry.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Business License with wholesale/remarketing scope; Second-Hand Machinery Circulation Record; Foreign Trade Operator Recordal (if importing/exporting); and Used Electromechanical Product Import Permit (if applicable).

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Ecology and Environment (MEE) through the local Ecology and Environment Bureau.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Environmental Registration (EIA filing record) under MEE's Classified Management List for Environmental Impact Assessment (2021), Category for general goods warehousing; Full Environmental Impact Report will be mandatory if the site includes disassembly, engine washing, painting, or hazardous waste storage beyond de minimis quantities.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Quantitative thresholds: (a) wastewater: no industrial process flow; sanitary sewage connected to municipal network must meet GB8978-1996 Level 3 limits, specifically COD not exceeding 500 mg/L, BOD5 not exceeding 300 mg/L, suspended solids not exceeding 400 mg/L, and pH 6-9; (b) VOCs: if solvent-based degreasing, surface cleaning, or coating is performed, organized exhaust NMHC must not exceed 60 mg/m3 and fugitive NMHC must be managed under GB16297-1996; (c) hazardous waste: waste hydraulic oil, lubricating oil, and oily rags must be classified as HW06/HW08/HW49, stored in sealed labeled containers inside a dedicated hazardous waste warehouse, transferred to a licensed hazardous waste operator within 180 days, and accompanied by an electronic waste manifest.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Acceptance Opinion issued by the local Fire and Rescue Division confirming operational hydrants, certified extinguishers, smoke alarms, and unobstructed exits; Civil Defense structural approval from the local People's Air Defense Office if the facility has a basement floor; structural load certificate from a licensed structural engineer verifying that the warehouse floor can bear excavator and roller static and dynamic loads; Work Safety Registration with the local Emergency Management Bureau covering forklift certificates, overhead crane registration, electrical safety inspection, and emergency response drills.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration of the People's Republic of China (STA); mandatory online access through the nationwide Electronic Tax Administration (E-Tax) platform and provincial-level E-Tax Bureau portals operated under the STA's unified digital tax system.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a foreign investor establishing a Chinese WFOE, the statutory procedure is: (1) complete incorporation with the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) and obtain the Business License showing the 18-digit Unified Social Credit Code (USCC), which legally serves as both the corporate TIN and the VAT ID; (2) allow the automatic SAMR-STA data synchronization to create the tax profile, then activate tax registration on the E-Tax portal; (3) file the taxpayer profile, legal representative, responsible finance officer, accounting system, business premises, and bank account information; (4) determine VAT status as Small-Scale Taxpayer or General VAT Taxpayer and apply for electronic invoice issuance quotas; (5) for export activities, complete the customs import/export enterprise filing, obtain the Customs Declaration operating code, and make the export tax rebate (exemption) filing with the competent STA tax office. A pure foreign non-resident seller without a Chinese establishment is generally not required to register for VAT on the export of goods where title passes offshore, but the WFOE is a Chinese resident legal entity and must carry full tax registration from incorporation.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation: the WFOE is a Chinese resident limited liability company subjected to Enterprise Income Tax at the 25% headline CIT rate on worldwide income; no pass-through regime applies, and dividend distributions to foreign shareholders are subject to 10% withholding tax unless reduced under an applicable tax treaty.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None for corporate income tax classification; China does not provide check-the-box elections or hybrid mismatch elections for a WFOE. The only relevant election is VAT status: a taxpayer whose annual taxable sales are below the RMB 5,000,000 threshold may elect voluntarily to become a General VAT Taxpayer; taxpayers above the threshold are mandatorily General VAT Taxpayers.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Value-Added Tax) under the Value-Added Tax Law of the People's Republic of China and implementing VAT regulations, together with the state export tax rebate system.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: CNY 5,000,000 (RMB 5 million) annual taxable turnover is the mandatory economic threshold above which a taxpayer must register as a General VAT Taxpayer; below the threshold, Small-Scale Taxpayer status applies, and monthly taxable sales up to CNY 100,000 (quarterly CNY 300,000) are exempt from VAT for small-scale taxpayers.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: China operates the Golden Tax Project IV fiscal supervision system with near-real-time invoice data transmission. All commercial VAT invoices must be issued through the STA-controlled Electronic Tax Bureau platform or integrated API-based billing systems; fully digitalized electronic invoices (FDEI) are cryptographically signed with tax-control codes and carry unique national invoice sequence numbers. VAT special invoices must pass authority verification and reconciliation before input VAT credits or export VAT rebates can be claimed; paper invoices, where still permitted, require digital anti-fraud stamping and tax authority code allocation.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods exported from China qualify for a 0% VAT rate and output VAT exemption only where the goods are physically loaded and cleared by Chinese Customs under an export declaration, the seller is a VAT-registered taxpayer holding a valid export rebate filing, the export proceeds are collected from the overseas buyer through banking channels and verified under the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) trade monitoring system, and the entire purchase-to-export invoice and documentation chain is retained. For used construction excavators, the WFOE must show traceable input VAT evidence, include model and serial number details consistent with the export declaration, and satisfy any applicable Customs control or used mechanical machinery export requirements; failure to substantiate the actual export or repatriation of proceeds disqualifies the 0% rate and the associated VAT rebate.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Goods Declaration (China Customs export declaration form with the 18-digit declaration number and 'Export' trade regime code)
Original transport document: Bill of Lading, Air Waybill, or multimodal cargo receipt proving discharge from a Chinese customs port
Commercial invoice and detailed packing list describing the used construction excavator, serial numbers, model, and declared customs value
Export sales contract or purchase order between the WFOE and the overseas buyer
VAT special invoice or validated VAT purchase invoice evidencing the input VAT chain for the used equipment
Export invoice issued to the overseas buyer in a foreign settlement currency with full commercial terms
Bank receipt or SWIFT MT103 confirming export proceeds from the overseas buyer, supported by the SAFE trade monitoring collection verification record
Export tax rebate/exemption declaration package prepared on the STA E-Tax portal, including the Export Goods VAT Rebate declaration and its supporting ledgers
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Under the Law of the People's Republic of China on the Administration of Tax Collection and the Administrative Measures for Export Tax Refund (Exemption), tax authorities may suspend, refuse, or claw back any export zero-rating or VAT refund where the customs, transport, input invoice, or FX collection documentation is missing, inconsistent, or artificial. The clawback includes the full refunded tax plus late-payment interest of 0.05% per day and an administrative penalty ranging from 50% to 500% of the evaded or fraudulently refunded tax. If export proceeds are not received within 180 days without an approved exception, the export VAT zero-rating is reversed, VAT becomes assessable as a domestic taxable supply, and additional late surcharges apply. Knowingly submitting forged customs declarations, bills of lading, or remittance evidence constitutes tax fraud under Article 204 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China, punishable by criminal detention, fixed-term imprisonment, life imprisonment, fines, and confiscation of property; false Customs declarations may additionally trigger Customs Law penalties including fines, seizure of goods, and suspension of import/export qualification.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) under the People's Bank of China (PBOC)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: China operates a managed floating exchange rate regime with current-account RMB convertibility and strict capital-account controls administered by SAFE. A WFOE may convert foreign-currency investment for operating purposes under an FDI registration, but free convertibility is not available for speculative or unapproved balance-of-payment items. Current payments such as trade settlements, service fees, dividends, and royalties are generally permitted once the underlying transaction is verified against the authenticated commercial documents, customs declarations, invoices, and tax compliance proof. Profit remittance requires an annual audit or tax filing record, a foreign-exchange payment application, and the absence of unresolved tax assessments; since 2017, banks independently verify the tax status through the tax department interface before releasing dividends. Capital reductions, exit proceeds, and loan repayments require SAFE special approval or filing. For export receipts, no forced conversion is required, however the proceeds must be received into a licensed foreign-exchange settlement account and reconcile with the customs trade data within the regulatory window. Any conversion from foreign exchange into CNY must be channeled through a designated bank, and the CNY cannot be freely converted back in excess of the approved capital account quota. The overall assessment is that liquidity is controllable but operationally layered with documentary compliance.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Export proceeds must enter China through a designated SAFE-monitored bank account and be declared to the SAFE trade monitoring system within 30 days after settlement. The mandatory conversion ratio is 0% — enterprises may retain export foreign currency in settlement accounts indefinitely; however, nothing may remain unreported, and conversion from foreign exchange to RMB must be supported by customs declaration, contract, invoice, and transport documents.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Offshore digital EMIs such as Revolut, Wise, or Airwallex cannot act as a KYC-passed clearing bank for a mainland WFOE. They lack PBoC/SAFE licenses to process FX capital flows, cannot issue domestic CNY account numbers, and are legally barred from servicing entities domiciled in the Chinese customs and SAFE surveillance net. Viability is Low. Such EMIs may only support non-China ancillary subsidiaries; the mainland entity must use a local tier-1 bank for all statutory FX and RMB settlement.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For a WFOE, at least one natural-person legal representative or a locally appointed executive must appear physically in branch for the initial high-risk account opening; non-resident directors may use a notarized and legalized power of attorney plus passport original at a Chinese embassy or consulate, followed by authenticated documents transmitted to the bank. Pure remote digital onboarding is generally refused; no fully online account opening exists for foreign-owned trading entities.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate beneficial owner opacity in cross-border shareholding chain
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Corporate registry certificates from all intermediate jurisdictions, notarized UBO declaration demonstrating ownership of 25% or more, passport copies and address proof for all ultimate owners, organizational chart, and source-of-wealth statements for shareholders.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade mismatch between declared used excavator trading and payment flows
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full commercial contracts, pro forma invoices, bill of lading, customs export or import declarations, pre-shipment inspection certificates, independent valuation reports for used machinery, and equipment serial numbers or VIN/IMEI records.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions or adverse media exposure of counterparties
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: World-Check, Dow Jones, or Refinitiv screening reports for all counterparties and beneficial owners, negative news search results, signed declaration of no ties to sanctioned entities, and enhanced due diligence questionnaire responses.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclear source of initial capital for a 100% foreign-owned entity
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bank statements of the foreign parent company, audited financial statements, statutory audit report, capital commitment letter, evidence of previous economic activity, tax records, and confirmation that all funds were routed through regulated banking channels.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital injection must be routed through the WFOE's designated FDI capital account after completing SAFE foreign-exchange registration. The overseas parent must issue a board resolution approving the capital contribution and remit the funds via SWIFT using the purpose code for foreign direct investment equity injection. The bank will perform a capital verification against the SAFE registration; after receipt, a Chinese certified public accountant issues a capital verification report. Proceeds must not be credited to personal accounts or to undesignated operational accounts. All wire instructions must reference the WFOE's name, SAFE FDI code, and the equity investment purpose.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade disbursements for used construction excavators will primarily settle via SWIFT MT103 for operational payments such as freight, insurance, spare parts, and commissions; major cross-border equipment purchases should use commercial letters of credit with conforming transport documents; documentary collections are acceptable for balance-of-trade finance with bill of lading, invoice, packing list, and inspection certificate. All outward remittances require underlying trade or service contracts and transaction numbers reported to the SAFE trade monitoring system. CIPS can be used for RMB-denominated transactions, but foreign-currency legs must clear through the tier-1 bank's SWIFT network.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable FX forwards matched to real trade settlement or capital account cash flows
Onshore FX swaps for same-day or next-day funding conversion between CNY and trade currency
Cross-currency swaps for approved long-term foreign currency liabilities
Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) are not permitted for onshore entities without SAFE approval and are prohibited as speculative overlay instruments

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Enterprise Credit Information Report (annual public disclosure covering shareholders, assets, revenue, investments, guarantees, and pledges)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) through the local Municipal/Provincial Administration for Market Regulation using the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Must be submitted between 1 January and 30 June of the year following the reporting fiscal year; China Standard Time (UTC+8) applies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to publish by 30 June leads to inclusion on the List of Enterprises Operating Abnormally; if the omission is not cured within three years the company is placed on the Serious Illegal and Untrustworthy Enterprise List, its legal representative/manager is barred from serving in the same role for three years, and the SAMR may revoke the business licence where the company has ceased business for six or more consecutive months (administrative strike-off equivalent).

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Foreign Investment Information Annual Report (FIE Annual Report) under the Foreign Investment Law 2019 and Foreign Investment Information Reporting Measures 2020
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM) with local commerce departments, submitted through the same SAMR National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Same annual window from 1 January through 30 June for the prior calendar year; material changes (actual controller, equity transfer, contribution change, merger/division, liquidation) must be reported within 30 days of the event
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: If the report is not submitted or is falsely submitted, the commerce authority orders rectification; refusal to correct attracts administrative fines in the CNY 100,000-300,000 band and public credit sanctions; for egregious cases the WFOE's foreign-exchange and customs goodwill is impaired and the business licence may be revoked under the SME registration rules.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Settlement (Corporate Income Tax Annual Reconciliation and Final Filing)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) through the competent local tax office; electronically filed via the e-tax bureau
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 May following the year-end; no extension beyond this statutory final deadline for ordinary enterprises
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing triggers a CNY 2,000-10,000 administrative fine (or up to CNY 100,000 for serious repetitive non-filing) plus a statutory daily late-payment surcharge of 0.05% on the unsettled tax for every day after the due date; continued non-compliance can lead to asset seizure, restriction of export invoices, and tax registration inactivation, which eventually prevents lawful trading and supports deregistration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Statutory Annual Financial Report Audit and Certification by a PRC-licensed Certified Public Accountant (CPA) firm
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Prepared and maintained at the WFOE's registered office; the signed audit report is made available to the shareholders, SAMR, tax authorities, SAFE, and lenders on lawful demand (no separate public annual audit filing fee)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual financial statements must be prepared and the independent audit completed within four months after the 31 December balance-sheet date unless the shareholders' meeting approves an earlier date; in all cases the audit opinion must exist before the company's annual shareholders/members approval of the financial report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to obtain the statutory audit violates PRC Company Law and Accounting Law; the company and directly liable personnel may be ordered to rectify, administrative fines may be imposed, the audit report will be unavailable for the tax/SAMR/FIE annual reports, and the WFOE's foreign exchange annual inspection and banking facilities will be restricted.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Compulsory audit is a zero-threshold mandate for every PRC limited liability company, including the target WFOE. There are no balance-sheet, turnover, or headcount exemptions: even a zero-asset, zero-revenue, zero-employee WFOE must engage an independent PRC-licensed CPA firm to audit its annual financial statements. The legal triggers are the PRC Company Law (financial report must be audited), the Accounting Law, and the FIE information reporting regime under the Foreign Investment Law. In addition, an audit becomes unconditionally necessary if the WFOE reports asset/operating data in the SAMR annual report, applies for SAFE dividend remittance under audit-based verification, or is required by an overseas parent for IFRS consolidation purposes.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Chinese Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises (CAS/ASBE), substantially converged with IFRS, issued by the Ministry of Finance; public statements and statutory financial statements are prepared under full CAS; if the WFOE is a parent of a Chinese subgroup, consolidated statutory statements under CAS and an IFRS consolidation pack under IFRS as adopted by the parent are required; eligible small-scale domestic holding vehicles could alternatively apply the Small Enterprise Accounting Standards, but a WFOE acting as a trading/procurement entity is expected to apply full CAS.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The PRC does not maintain a public UBO register. Instead, the WFOE's actual controller, equity chain, voting agreements, and material financing arrangements are collected through the annual FIE information report and the SAMR annual report. The statutory annual confirmation cycle runs from 1 January to 30 June. Any change in the actual controller or any transfer of equity must also be filed with SAMR within 30 days after the transfer and then reflected in the company's register of shareholders. Until the register is updated and the change is registered, the transfer may not be invoked against the company or against bona fide third parties. The corporate compliance officer should conduct a December year-end register audit and reconcile the share register, minutes, powers of attorney, and charge/security file before the annual report window opens.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Directors, Supervisors and Legal Representative
Minutes of General Meetings, Board Meetings and Written Resolutions
Register of Charges/Mortgages and Security Interests over assets
Accounting Books, Vouchers, Bank Statements and Financial Statements

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 300 - USD 1,500 per year for a registered address and local corporate/secretarial agent service in a Tier-2 provincial city; USD 1,500 - USD 3,000 in Beijing/Shanghai/Shenzhen for a WFOE with physical office or compliance-intensive operations
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,000 - USD 6,000 for a small or single-entity WFOE with simple wholesale trading; USD 6,000 - USD 12,000 where consolidated IFRS reporting pack, inventory existence testing of used construction excavators, intercompany balances, SAFE dividend remittance, or transaction testing of high-value equipment sales is required

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% standard China Enterprise Income Tax rate under Article 4 of the PRC Enterprise Income Tax Law
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Small low-profit enterprises are taxed at a 20% reduced rate with an effective 5% rate on the first RMB 3 million of taxable income; National High-Tech Enterprises may qualify for 15%; qualified R&D expenditures may be super-deducted at 100%; a used construction machinery trading WFOE ordinarily remains at 25% unless it qualifies under a specific incentive regime.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual Enterprise Income Tax Return (Form A, form code A100000) for resident enterprises, filed electronically through the State Taxation Administration Electronic Tax Bureau portal and provincial e-tax terminals.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual final reconciliation with quarterly provisional EIT prepayments.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Provisional EIT prepayment is due within 15 calendar days after the end of each quarter; the annual EIT return and final tax payment are due within 5 calendar months after the fiscal year-end (December 31).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Report the gross turnover from sales of secondhand hydraulic excavators, rollers, and other used construction earthmoving equipment, net of VAT.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The WFOE must book all export sales in its Chinese ledger and reconcile reported revenue with customs export declarations. Where the foreign parent is contractually the seller but the WFOE habitually negotiates and concludes contracts, the WFOE may be treated as a deemed permanent establishment of the non-resident, triggering CIT and business tax exposure in China. Offshore settlement or splitting sales proceeds through foreign bank accounts is a red flag for tax evasion.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Include the acquisition cost of used excavators, including auction purchase prices, import duties, freight, inspection, cleaning, and reconditioning costs, excluding VAT.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For purchases from related non-resident suppliers, the invoice price must be arm's length and supportable under the Comparable Uncontrolled Price method or Transactional Net Margin Method. Inflated import prices from related offshore affiliates will trigger transfer pricing adjustment and corresponding underpayment interest, especially where the WFOE has no function beyond taking title.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Report city maintenance and construction tax, education surcharge, and local education surcharge paid on domestic turnover; VAT itself is not deductible as cost.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Zero-rated or VAT-exempt export of used machinery must be supported by export customs declarations and VAT export filings. A mismatch between A100000 operating revenue and the VAT export turnover schedule will create an automatic tax audit flag indicating unreported revenue or artificial export invoicing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 4 (A100000 Line 4) - Selling, General and Administrative Expenses
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Include local wages, warehouse and yard rental, logistics, legal and professional fees, sales commissions, and ordinary administrative expenses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Management fees paid or recharged by a foreign head office are non-deductible unless directly related to services received and substantiated with contracts, invoices, vouchers, and demonstrable economic benefit. Royalties paid to a related non-resident for trading know-how or brand use must pass a beneficial ownership review and face withholding tax; a back-to-back royalty structure with no local substance will be disallowed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Compute operating profit plus non-operating revenue less non-operating expenses before tax adjustments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign exchange gains or losses from USD and letter-of-credit receivables must be recognized under the tax law. Interest-free loans from a non-resident shareholder are subject to thin capitalization scrutiny; deemed interest may be imputed and disallowed if the related-party debt-to-equity ratio exceeds the 2:1 limit under PRC Enterprise Income Tax Law Article 46.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Enter additions and deductions to total profit, including non-deductible entertainment expenses, transfer pricing adjustments, thin-capitalization interest disallowances, and other tax-law-specific adjustments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: All cross-border related-party transactions must be reported in the annual related-party transaction report and contemporaneous documentation schedules. A failure to prepare the transfer pricing documentation gives the tax authority the right to assess taxable income using available information and imposes an additional special tax adjustment interest charge.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Calculate the final taxable income after applying the 5-year general loss carryforward and any foreign tax credits or special exemptions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Losses generated during a year in which the WFOE lacked business purpose or economic substance may be audited and disallowed. Undistributed profits retained in a low-taxed overseas affiliate controlled by the WFOE can be reattributed to the Chinese entity under the Controlled Foreign Corporation rules.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 8 (A100000 Lines 13-14) - EIT Payable and Credits
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Apply the 25% statutory rate, or applicable preferential rate, and subtract foreign tax credits, then derive the final EIT payable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign tax credits are available only for foreign-source income with underlying evidence of foreign tax paid. Dividends distributed out of retained post-tax earnings are not deductible for the WFOE and will generate a 10% dividend withholding tax, or a reduced treaty rate, at the point of repatriation to a non-resident shareholder.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing is subject to a penalty of up to RMB 10,000 plus a daily surcharge of 0.05% on unpaid tax under PRC Tax Administration Law Articles 32 and 62. For intentional under-declaration of revenue, Article 63 requires recovery of the unpaid tax plus a fine of between 50% and 500% of the underpaid amount. Criminal liability attaches under Criminal Law Article 201, with imprisonment up to 7 years and fines where tax evasion exceeds the criminal threshold; fraudulent export VAT refunds carry similar criminal exposure under Criminal Law Article 204.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% statutory withholding tax on dividends paid by a Chinese resident WFOE to a non-resident enterprise shareholder under PRC Enterprise Income Tax Law Articles 3 and 37, subject to reduction under an applicable bilateral Double Tax Treaty.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To claim treaty relief the non-resident shareholder must, before the dividend distribution, provide the Chinese withholding agent and the competent tax authority with: (i) a valid Tax Residency Certificate issued by the residence jurisdiction; (ii) a beneficial ownership statement and supporting documentation proving that the shareholder is not looking through to another entity, not merely a conduit, and meets the substantive requirements of the relevant treaty article; and (iii) the prescribed treaty relief application form on which it declares both entitlement and treaty article. The withholding agent files the withholding return and applies the reduced rate only upon administrative acceptance, or the shareholder may file for a refund if tax was withheld at the statutory rate.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding tax on interest and royalties paid to non-resident enterprises is 10%. Bilateral tax treaties commonly reduce interest and royalty withholding rates to 5-10%, depending on creditor ownership percentage, beneficial ownership, and the precise technical-fee/royalty definition in the relevant treaty; the WFOE must document the actual use of intangible assets or the genuine debtor-creditor relationship and must not apply treaty relief to proportionality payments lacking economic substance.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File documentation must be prepared when total annual related-party transactions exceed RMB 40 million; Master File documentation must be prepared when aggregate annual related-party transactions exceed RMB 1 billion.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP, Resale Price, Cost Plus, TNMM, Profit Split
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Although China does not label its regime as Economic Substance Regulations, the PRC Enterprise Income Tax Law contains a general anti-avoidance rule, substance-over-form doctrine, and the OECD BEPS Principal Purpose Test. The WFOE must demonstrate core income-generating activities in China, including source and procurement of used excavators, pre-shipment inspection, storage, negotiation, export documentation, credit risk assumption, and logistics management. A company without these activities will be treated as a shell and face reallocation of profit to foreign principal, deemed permanent establishment, or denial of treaty benefits.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion - Deliberate Omission of Export Revenue
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The WFOE maintains dual ledgers, under-reports proceeds from used excavator export sales, splits payment via letter of credit and unrelated foreign bank accounts, and shifts gross profit to an offshore related shell company while retaining the procurement and inspection functions in China.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: PRC Tax Administration Law Article 63 imposes recovery of underpaid tax plus a fine of 50% to 500% of the unpaid amount; Article 32 imposes a 0.05% daily late-payment surcharge; Criminal Law Article 201 imposes imprisonment up to 7 years and criminal fines for willful concealment of taxable income above the statutory threshold.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who authorize false accounts or offshore diversion may face piercing of the corporate veil under PRC Company Law, become jointly and severally liable for the company's tax arrears, and suffer freezing and confiscation of personal assets. Residential and travel restrictions are imposed through the tax blacklisting and frontier-exit control system, and directors with criminal exposure may be detained and imprisoned.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing Abuse and Thin Capitalization
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The WFOE pays excessive interest, royalties, commissions, or management fees to a Hong Kong or Cayman related party for used construction machinery sourcing, fails to prepare Local File, Master File, and the annual related-party transaction report, and intentionally strips Chinese taxable profit through artificial intercompany agreements.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: PRC Enterprise Income Tax Law Article 41 allows recharacterization and adjustment of non-arm's length transactions; Article 44 permits the tax authority to assess profit using available information when documentation is absent; Article 46 disallows related-party interest exceeding the 2:1 debt-to-equity ratio; Tax Administration Law Article 62 imposes a fine of up to RMB 10,000 for filing failures, and special tax adjustment interest of 5 percentage points above the benchmark loan rate is applied.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who deliberately sign uncommercial intercompany agreements, transfer assets to related parties, or participate in a fraudulent scheme to reduce taxable income can be held personally liable for the restored tax debt and related interest. Courts and tax authorities may pierce the corporate veil, lift corporate personality, trace distributions into directors' personal accounts, impose exit bans under the tax blacklist system, and consolidate civil liability with criminal charges for fraud.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML / Shell Company / Economic Substance Abuse
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The WFOE is used as an invoice shell without physical yard, staff, inventory, or business management; wire transfers of used excavator proceeds are layered through multiple offshore shell bank accounts; beneficial ownership declarations to Chinese banks are false; the entity fails to document the ultimate foreign shareholder and instead is used to conceal tax evasion or illicit cross-border capital flows.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: PRC Anti-Money Laundering Law Articles 27 and 32 impose fines up to RMB 5 million, suspension of business, and revocation of licenses for concealment of beneficial ownership or violation of customer due diligence obligations; State Administration of Foreign Exchange Regulations impose a fine of 30% to 100% of unlawful foreign exchange proceeds; Criminal Law Article 191 imposes up to 10 years imprisonment and fines for money laundering.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who place this shell through repeated formations, make false declarations on the actual controller register, or commingle corporate and personal funds may see the corporate veil pierced, making them personally liable for all tax arrears and third-party claims. They also face criminal detention, personal fines, seizure of personal assets, immediate exit controls, and permanent prohibition from acting as company directors in China.
